render_dimension.title: 2d_pixel_glow
render_dimension._consistency_anchor: crisp medium-granularity pixel art, cel-shading outlines, dithered cyan rune glow ONLY on energy/portal, deep navy-slate dominant background, LEAGUE-OF-LEGENDS chamfer-hexagon UI geometry, gold accent only on frames

art_direction.vibe: crisp medium pixel art, cel-shading outlines, Runeterra high-fantasy mood, epic cold mysterious noble restrained-luxury, gemstone rune cyan energy glow, forged-metal + natural-rock materials, cinematic cold dark lighting with cyan fill and gold rim, NOT 8-bit retro, NOT minecraft voxel, NOT tiny sprite, NOT smooth painterly, NOT 3D
art_direction.color_direction: dominant deep navy-blue & slate stone base, secondary gemstone rune cyan glow, gold accent only on frames/rims
art_direction.color_instruction: STRICT RATIO: deep navy-blue & slate stone #0E1E2E #16283A #3E4A52 dominant (~70%); gemstone rune cyan #2FB6E8 #5FD4F5 secondary (~15%) ONLY on portal/energy/current-node/glow; gold #C8A24A #E8C874 accent MAX 8% ONLY on frames/button-rims/icon-edges/stars (gold is a HIGHLIGHT not a fill, NEVER flood gold); tiny amethyst purple #8A5BC8 magic sparkle (~3%); muted forest green #6FBF7A ONLY in canyon foliage (~4%). NEVER let gold or cyan flood the whole screen.

character_lock.rule: When a character reference image is given, ALWAYS use img2img (image=[inner_url] + input_fidelity=high) and write 'use the EXACT same character from reference, do not redesign'. Reuse the SAME inner_url across every screen. Default to the CENTER-MOST character in a multi-hero reference unless the user specifies otherwise. Never invent a character from text alone.
character_lock.example_case: Garen 'The Might of Demacia': short brown hair, stubble beard, square-jaw rugged face, deep-blue cloth tunic + silver-white gold-trimmed plate armor, brown belt, NO cape / NO hood, large broadsword

negative_prompt.base: 8-bit retro grain, tiny sprite, minecraft voxel blocky, smooth painterly, 3d render, blurry mushy pixels, muddy colors, oversaturated, gold flooding everything, cluttered busy background, watermark, jpeg artifacts, random english gibberish

by_type.character: redesigned character, different face, cape, hood, photorealistic, deformed, extra limbs
by_type.background: cluttered scenery, busy distracting background, cyan flooding, low contrast between subject and UI
by_type.title-art: double image, ghosting text, misaligned duplicate layers, unreadable pixelation, typo
by_type.button: plain rounded rectangle button, flat-edge rectangle button, hexagon without chamfer, cyan-outline-only button, two mismatched buttons

negative_prompt.execution_bugs: double image / ghosting text; mixed-color lit stars (cyan-and-gold); lit stars different colors; duplicated / overlapping rune rings; same motif stacked twice in one screen
negative_prompt.style_conflict: warm sunset palette, desert tones, rose-gold vegas glam, art-deco, pastel cute, daylight bright sky, no-outline soft shading

vertical_layout_negative: NO phone mockup, NO smartphone frame, NO device bezel, NO rounded phone corners, NO hand holding phone, full-bleed edge to edge, no border frame
unified_component_spec: ### UNIFIED UI COMPONENT SPEC (STRICT - keep LEAGUE-OF-LEGENDS geometric DNA): PRIMARY ACTION BUTTON = ANGULAR HEXAGONAL button with CHAMFERED (beveled 45deg) corners + POINTED DIAMOND END-CAPS on left & right + inset layered bevel faces (mecha-tech, exactly like League of Legends button geometry) + thick gold beveled frame + deep navy-to-bright-blue gradient fill + cyan inner glow + bold gold Chinese lettering. Circular icon button = navy circle + gold chamfered ring + icon. Resource pill = gold-chamfer-framed capsule + round icon + number. Level node = hexagon/diamond chamfered tile + gold frame + number. Item slot = square navy + gold chamfered frame + icon + cyan glow. HP/MP bar = gold-chamfer-framed, cyan HP + blue MP. Avatar = hexagonal gold-chamfer frame. ALL screens reuse these IDENTICAL components, only content changes. DO NOT simplify chamfer into plain rounded rectangles.

asset_templates.character: pixel-art {subject} converted faithfully from reference (img2img), crisp medium pixel, cel-shading outline, deep-blue + silver-white gold-trimmed armor palette, cyan rune rim-light, on deep-navy background, do not redesign
asset_templates.background: clean restrained pixel scene, deep navy-slate base, minimal detail, dark fantasy canyon/ruins, uncluttered so subject and UI pop
asset_templates.background_hero: pixel key-art scene, dark fantasy canyon, one giant glowing cyan rune portal ring, distant mountains, volumetric cyan light beams, deep navy dominant, gold rim accents
asset_templates.level_map: vertical level-select MAP, NO hero figure, pure architecture & landscape: winding cyan path connecting numbered hexagon/diamond chamfered stage nodes climbing past fantasy buildings (rune portal gate, mage tower with glowing windows, broken roman columns, castle gatehouse, rune arches, shrine), dark canyon with pine forest
asset_templates.icon: pixel game icon, gold chamfered frame, dark navy fill, cyan glow edge
asset_templates.title-art: big pixel title text 「{immutable_text}」, gold-gradient embossed, clean single dark outline, cyan rune outer-glow, readable, NO double image NO ghosting
asset_templates.core_gameplay_action: side-view action combat in dark fantasy canyon/ruins, the locked hero centered-lower swinging weapon & casting cyan rune energy at a group of enemy monsters (wolves/stone golems), floating pixel damage numbers, chamfer HUD (hexagonal portrait + cyan HP + blue MP top-left, pause + wave counter top-right, circular chamfer skill buttons bottom-right, joystick bottom-left), restrained background

text_render_spec.css: title: pixel font, fill #E8C874 gold gradient, dark #0A1520 single clean outline, cyan outer-glow 0 0 14px rgba(47,182,232,.6); body: pixel font #EAF2FA; accent/number: cyan #2FB6E8 with soft glow; danger label: #E24B4A
